notes:
v1.6.0 Release:
- New look: side navigation (Media, Audio, Video, Series, Effects), subtitle panel with Subtitles / AI Dubbing / Voice tabs, and the new Midnight Indigo theme (the older looks stay in the presets)
- Timeline like a video editor: track names on the left, video thumbnails, the original sound's waveform, and each dubbed line drawn as its real waveform
- Isolate BGM: new MDX-Net engine, now the default, separates voice and music more cleanly; Spleeter, Demucs and FFmpeg are still there. It runs on your graphics card (DirectX 12) when it can - several times faster - and on the CPU otherwise
- Dub Whole Series: new "Videos are already merged" switch - each video you merged yourself is used as one part and only split, with no joining. It turns on by itself when every video is 20 minutes or longer
- Dub Whole Series fixes: a character name no longer replaces everyday Khmer words like "ជា", stray Latin words left in a Khmer line are translated again, the part SRTs match the dubbed lines, and each part shows its export progress
- Dub Whole Series no longer freezes its progress, audio and the joining part (red ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES errors) while 6 tabs transcribe at once
- More Drama Styles: horror, mystery, fantasy, family and youth
- Voices keep their own pitch: emotion changes only pace and loudness, and a line's Male/Female voice is kept after translation
- Gemini model list cleaned up: models Google has shut down (2.0 Flash, 1.5 Pro/Flash) and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (audio only, it can't make dubbing subtitles) are removed. A saved model that is gone switches to a working one by itself
- A cancelled or failed render no longer leaves a broken half-written file in the export folder
- New app logo
